GROK 4.5 DOMINATES ON EFFICIENCY WHILE STAYING COMPETITIVE AT THE FRONTIER

Grok 4.5 continues to stand out for its exceptional cost efficiency and token usage while remaining in the top tier of frontier models.

Key highlights:
•  Significantly lower cost per task compared to Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.6, and others
•  Strong token efficiency (often using far fewer tokens for similar or better results)
•  Competitive performance across intelligence and coding benchmarks
While some models edge it out on raw benchmark scores, Grok 4.5 consistently delivers one of the best performance-to-cost ratios available right now — making it especially practical for heavy real-world usage.
xAI’s focus on building capable and efficient models is clearly paying off.

BREAKING: SpaceXAI has announced the Grokathon, and applications are now open. 

• Selected builders will gather in San Francisco on August 8 for a 12-hour AI hackathon.
• Participants will receive exclusive access to the latest Grok models and X APIs.
• Meet the team behind Grok 4.5.
• Build and ship real AI applications in just 12 hours.
• Event prizes will be announced on-site.

Applications close on July 28 and are being reviewed on a rolling basis.

A unique opportunity for developers to build with frontier AI alongside the Grok team.

Tesla Cybertruck spotted towing a SpaceX Raptor 3 engine. 

A powerful combination of two of Elon's flagship technologies—Cybertruck handling one of the world's most advanced rocket engines.

Another glimpse of the close collaboration between Tesla and SpaceX.

BREAKING: SpaceX will report its Q2 2026 financial results on August 4. 

• Q2 2026 earnings will be released after market close on August 4.
• SpaceX management will host a live audio webcast at 3:30 p.m. CT / 4:30 p.m. ET.
• The webcast replay will be available on SpaceX Investor Relations.
• The event will also be livestreamed on X via @SpaceX.

Investors and space enthusiasts will get an update on SpaceX's latest financial and operational performance.
Imagine realizing you can go onto X and post a doge meme and that’s all it takes to get Elon’s attention

Italo is bringing Starlink to high-speed rail. 

The operator plans to equip its entire fleet with Starlink by 2027, delivering fast, reliable internet even at speeds of 300 km/h.

Another major step for Starlink beyond the skies and seas.
Life is so much easier when the only focus is on doge memes

NEWS: Zimbabwe is expanding digital connectivity through a unique Starlink initiative. 🇿🇼

• The Ministry of Information Communication Technology, Postal and Courier Services partnered with the National Blood Service Zimbabwe.
• Starlink kits are being donated to schools with the highest blood donation contributions.
• The initiative rewards community participation while improving internet access for students across the country.

Source: @NBSZbloodbank
